required_behaviors: The file must contain the exact move text as entered in the video, one move per line.
No guessed, placeholder, or partial move lists.

Obtain receipt-backed evidence of the move sequence source.
Verify /app/solution.txt contents against the extracted sequence with receipt-backed evidence.
finalization_evidence_required: receipt-backed evidence of the extracted move sequence source
receipt-backed evidence that the file matches the extracted sequence
